title: Automation event WiFi SSID contains space
symptom: An automation that triggers a temp basal based on time and WiFi SSID does not trigger when the SSID contains a space.
cause: The thread does not establish a root cause; the maintainer suggests the delimiter is set to ';' and it should work, and later a user reports that the space was not the problem but another condition prevented the automation.
fix: No definitive fix is stated; the maintainer added tests showing it works with spaces, and the original reporter found another condition was the issue.
evidence_quote: delimiter is set to ';' it should work
